category_title: Students in an inclusive urban classroom exhibiting high-frequency disruptive behaviors and low academic engagement
scenario_title: Transition to independent work during reader's workshop
minimal_context: The student is transitioning to independent work at their desk following a mini-reading lesson during reader's workshop.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The mini-reading lesson is finished. Please sit down at your desk and work on your assigned task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and walks away from the desk area, talking loudly to a peer) I'm not doing that right now!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to sit down and focus on your reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes past another student in the congested pathway between the desks) Move out of my way!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please keep your hands to yourself and go to your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a pencil across the room) This is stupid! I'm not doing this [profanity] work!
